calls.video_title: Amazon Delivers Fantastic News for Uber Stock Investors
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (was BUY 7 Nov, FV $125) — Amazon Prime members now get free Uber Eats delivery on $25+ orders plus $20 off their first two orders; he expects higher order frequency and sees the partnership as a step toward Amazon listing its Zoox driverless cars on Uber, easing the biggest risk hanging over the stock. The news only makes him more bullish; he owns both stocks.
calls.base_case: Free delivery removes the biggest constraint on ordering; more frequent orders benefit Uber, its partners and drivers.
calls.bull_case: Amazon lists Zoox driverless cars on Uber's platform and Waymo follows — the driverless risk premium collapses.
calls.bear_case: Uber One members cancel ($9.99/mo) for the Prime benefit — he judges the net effect small since members' perks roughly offset the fee.

calls.price_at_call: Fair value $125 (~75% undervalued, stated); forward PE 16.3 (stated); trading price not stated (up 7.35% on the day)
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (was BUY 2 Nov, FV $122) - still one of the best stocks to buy right now, high conviction, ranking updated 4 Nov 2026. Post-earnings update: revenue +10% to $14.8B, adj EBITDA +31% to ~$3B, stock +7% the day after results; DCF fair value raised to $125.
calls.base_case: Gross bookings guided $64.25B at midpoint (+20% YoY); 215M+ monthly active platform customers (+14% YoY); operating cash flow $2.6B in the quarter.
calls.bull_case: Driverless is an opportunity, not just a risk: ~$22B of driver payments could be captured if an AV ride costs less than a driver ride, boosting profitability and letting Uber cut prices; Tesla AV rollout slower than expected (Texas election results, bureaucracy); Uber's customer relationships and brand are a moat a new AV provider must build from scratch.
calls.bear_case: Mobility revenue fell 2% on a lower take rate despite mobility gross bookings +18% YoY; driverless remains a huge risk if Tesla/Waymo scale fast; stock still underperforming the S&P 500.
